explanation: It is 0 at every D1 and GO step and only turns on at D2, where the value depends on this trial choice and grows with trial number. After choosing a1, D2 is about 4 near trials 20-40, 5 near 50, 6 near 75 and 9-10 from trial 90 on; after choosing a2 it is about 0-1 up to trial 70, 2-4 around trials 75-90 and 7-8 from trial 95 on, and whether the state reached was common or rare, or whether a reward came, barely matters.
